source_preview:
AI Generalist (Fresher)
Job Title: AI Generalist (Fresher)
Location: Mumbai
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-site
About the Role:
We are looking for enthusiastic freshers who are eager to explore, learn, and
implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts in real-world projects. As an AI
Generalist, you will be part of a growing startup team experimenting with data,
automation, and AI-driven solutions across various business areas.
Key Responsibilities:
Learn and apply fundamentals of AI, Machine Learning, and Data Processing.
Assist in building simple AI models, data pipelines, and automation workflows.
Research and explore AI tools, frameworks, and APIs for implementation.
Support proof-of-concept (PoC) development and documentation.
Collaborate with mentors and teammates to test and deploy new ideas.
Desired Skills:
Basic understanding of Python, data handling, or AI concepts.
Curiosity to learn new technologies and solve problems creatively.
Good logical thinking and teamwork skills.
No prior experience required – just a willingness to learn and grow.
Who Can Apply:
Fresh graduates or final-year students from Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or
related backgrounds who are passionate about AI and innovation.
